reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Classification as Missouri mutuals and formation bar
headings.reviewNote: County, town, and farmers' mutuals designated Missouri mutual insurance companies operating under sections 380.011 to 380.151; no new companies.

headings.title: Mandatory registration statement filing with director
headings.reviewNote: Companies must file registration statement with director within 90 days of January 1, 1985; compiled list filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Charter forfeiture for failure to file registration statement
headings.reviewNote: Secretary of state irrevocably forfeits corporate charter of any mutual company failing to file timely registration statement.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; Missouri mutual classification, new-company bar, 90-day 1985 registration, and irrevocable charter forfeiture verified.

headings.title: Authorized property perils and motor vehicle insurance exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Authorized on assessable not-for-profit mutual basis for specified property perils; motor vehicles and credit transactions excluded.

headings.title: Territorial limits, statewide crop insurance, and reserve funds
headings.reviewNote: Business limited to home and adjoining counties; statewide crop insurance permitted with $300,000 reserve and reinsurance.

headings.title: Chapter 355 corporate powers and reserve accumulation
headings.reviewNote: Possesses chapter 355 powers; may distribute underwriting gains and accumulate reasonable reserves for losses.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); property perils, § 301.010 motor vehicle/credit exclusions, $300k statewide crop reserve, and ch. 355 powers verified.

headings.title: Board of directors election, terms, and officer selection
headings.reviewNote: Board of at least five insured property owners elected for 1-3 years; directors elect president, vice president, secretary, and treasurer.

headings.title: Annual membership meeting date, time, and location
headings.reviewNote: Annual meeting held per articles, followed immediately by board meeting; default is first Monday in February at registered office.

headings.title: Annual meeting notice on policy and by publication
headings.reviewNote: Notice mailed/printed on policy and published once a week for two weeks in county newspaper before meeting.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 3 title; board/officers, annual meeting default, and policy/newspaper notice verified.

headings.title: Periodic examination of company affairs by director
headings.reviewNote: Director or agents make careful examination of company affairs whenever deemed necessary in director's discretion.

headings.title: Examiner powers, oaths, witness summons, and subpoenas
headings.reviewNote: Examiners may compel attendance, examine under oath directors, officers, and employees, and compel record production.

headings.title: Scope of examination inquiry and member security
headings.reviewNote: Inquiry examines corporate resources, management methods, director actions, and security provided to members.

headings.title: Refusal to permit examination as grounds for dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Refusal to permit examination constitutes sufficient cause for proceedings to wind up affairs under section 380.071.

headings.title: Payment of examination expenses by examined company
headings.reviewNote: Expenses of examination, as determined by director, paid by company examined.

headings.title: Acceptance of independent CPA examination report
headings.reviewNote: Director may accept financial examination report prepared by independent certified public accountant in lieu of state examination.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 6 title; examination powers, § 380.071 refusal winding-up, expenses, and independent CPA report verified.

headings.title: Notice of unsafe business condition or insufficient assets
headings.reviewNote: Director sends written notice if financial statement, examination, or other information indicates unsafe operations or deficient assets.

headings.title: Reasonable time to cure and judicial injunction proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Reasonable cure time allowed; failure to cure triggers circuit court proceedings to enjoin business and dissolve corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); unsafe-operation/asset-deficiency notice, cure discretion, and circuit court injunction/liquidation verified.

headings.title: Noncompliance notice, compliance order, and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Directs written noncompliance notice and permits director, after ch. 536 hearing, to order company into compliance with ch. 536 judicial review.

headings.title: Winding up and injunction for order noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Makes refusal or neglect to comply with compliance order cause for winding-up proceedings and permits director to seek § 380.071 injunction.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); replaced both completely mismatched draft titles/notes (erroneously describing § 380.051 annual statements) with ch. 536 noncompliance orders and § 380.071 winding-up/injunction headings.

headings.title: Policy and application form filings and disapproval grounds
headings.reviewNote: Applications, policy forms, and riders filed with director; forms usable upon filing unless disapproved as deceptive or unlawful.

headings.title: Judicial review of form disapproval under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Any disapproval of form by director subject to judicial review under provisions of chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); form filings, disapproval grounds, and ch. 536 judicial review verified.

headings.title: Board authority to require initial membership fee
headings.reviewNote: Company may require payment of membership fee determined by board of directors before issuing policy.

headings.title: Assessment alone or premium plus assessment operating basis
headings.reviewNote: Company may operate upon basis of assessments alone or upon premium plus assessment basis.

headings.title: Mandatory risk deposit under assessment-alone plan
headings.reviewNote: Assessment-alone company requires deposit of defined percentage of assumed risk determined by directors before policy issuance.

headings.title: Premium payment and promissory notes under premium-plus-assessment basis
headings.reviewNote: Premium-plus-assessment company may accept 10% cash plus demand promissory note payable when directors deem necessary for losses.

headings.title: Assessment in anticipation of losses and reserve accumulation
headings.reviewNote: Company may assess members in anticipation of losses for next two calendar years and accumulate reasonable reserve fund.

headings.title: Return of unconsumed deposits and note cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Company returns unconsumed deposits/premiums and cancels uncalled promissory notes consistent with maintaining adequate reserves.

headings.title: Post-termination assessment nonliability and one-year notice rule
headings.reviewNote: Policyholder not liable for subsequent losses, nor prior obligations unless assessment notice given within one year after termination.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 6 title; membership fees, assessment/premium-plus bases, 10% note rule, 2-year anticipation, returns, and 1-year post-termination notice verified.

headings.title: Loss assessment and policy cancellation on assessment basis
headings.reviewNote: Directors verify loss or judgment and assess members in proportion to risk; nonpayment within 30 days justifies policy cancellation.

headings.title: Loss payments, borrowing, and assessment under premium-plus basis
headings.reviewNote: Losses paid from premiums/notes; deficiency assessed once per year; directors may borrow funds pending assessment collection.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); assessment-basis and premium-plus-basis loss/judgment payments, annual assessment cap, borrowing, and 30-day cancellation verified.

headings.title: Board resolution to operate as extended Missouri mutual
headings.reviewNote: Company operating under sections 380.011 to 380.151 may elect extended mutual powers by board resolution filed with director.

headings.title: Transfer of records from secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Upon election, secretary of state transfers records to director for custody, retaining duplicate copies.

headings.title: Director compliance review and certificate of authority issuance
headings.reviewNote: Director determines compliance and issues certificate of authority to commence business as extended Missouri mutual.

headings.title: Transition of former sections 380.580 to 380.840 companies
headings.reviewNote: All companies formerly operating under sections 380.580 to 380.840 shall operate under sections 380.201 to 380.591.

headings.title: Agent licensing examination exemption for electing companies
headings.reviewNote: Agents active for one year exempt from examination if company elected extended status within thirty days of January 1, 1985.

headings.title: Pre-1993 election by chapter 379 mutual companies
headings.reviewNote: Chapter 379 mutuals doing business only in Missouri could elect extended mutual status before December 31, 1992, by amending articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1984, 1992); tightened subsections 2, 4, and 6 titles; extended mutual election, records transfer, § 375.018 agent exam exemption, and Dec. 31, 1992 ch. 379 election deadline verified.

headings.title: Statewide business authority and county designation in articles
headings.reviewNote: Company may do business throughout Missouri but not outside state; counties specified in articles and certificate.

headings.title: Minimum membership requirement of one hundred members
headings.reviewNote: Extended Missouri mutual company must maintain membership of at least one hundred members.

headings.title: Prohibition on deceptively similar corporate names
headings.reviewNote: Name of company cannot be deceptively similar to any other insurance company authorized in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); Missouri-only territory, 100-member minimum, and deceptive name prohibition verified.

headings.title: Article amendments by two-thirds vote and filing
headings.reviewNote: Articles amended by two-thirds vote of members upon 30 days' notice; filed with director under sections 375.206 to 375.221.

headings.title: Bylaw amendments and filing with director
headings.reviewNote: Bylaws amended as provided therein, filed with director, and must be consistent with law and articles.

headings.title: Filing fee for article or bylaw amendments
headings.reviewNote: A fee of ten dollars is imposed for each amendment to articles of incorporation or bylaws filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; two-thirds article amendments under §§ 375.206–375.221, bylaw filings, and $10 fee verified.

headings.title: Filing, deemed approval, and disapproval of forms
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing policy forms and endorsements; forms are deemed approved upon filing unless disapproved as inconsistent or deceptive, with right to hearing.

headings.title: Mandatory policy disclosures on assessability and annual meeting
headings.reviewNote: All policies must print whether policy is assessable and when and where annual meeting will be held.

headings.title: Filing fee for policy and endorsement forms
headings.reviewNote: A fee of ten dollars is imposed for each policy form or endorsement filed.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); corrected subsection 1 title/note (forms deemed approved upon filing, no 30-day wait); assessability/meeting disclosure and $10 fee verified.

headings.title: Guaranty fund and reinsurance requirements by line
headings.reviewNote: Sets minimum guaranty funds for fire, wind, liability, crop, and line 5; reinsurance required to protect stability.

headings.title: Cumulative requirements and guaranty fund ceiling
headings.reviewNote: Financial requirements construed cumulatively, capped at maximum guaranty fund of $1,600,000 plus reinsurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1984, 1991); tightened both titles; line-by-line guaranty fund/reinsurance requirements under § 380.261 and cumulative $1.6M ceiling verified.

headings.title: Petition and articles of merger submitted to director
headings.reviewNote: When membership approves plan of merger, companies petition director for approval or modification.

headings.title: Director review and hearing waiver for nonprejudicial mergers
headings.reviewNote: Director reviews petition and may waive hearing upon finding merger does not prejudice policyholder interests.

headings.title: Published notice of merger petition hearing
headings.reviewNote: Director may require published notice in two daily newspapers, including Jefferson City, for two successive weeks.

headings.title: Merger hearing procedure, witness subpoenas, and testimony
headings.reviewNote: Director conducts hearing, examines affairs, summons witnesses and records; members and public may appear.

headings.title: Director approval or modification of proposed merger
headings.reviewNote: Director approves or modifies merger upon finding policyholder interests are properly protected and no objections exist.

headings.title: Payment of proceeding costs by petitioning companies
headings.reviewNote: Expenses and costs incident to merger proceeding paid by petitioning companies upon order of director.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 3 title; § 380.281 merger petition, hearing waiver, Jefferson City notice, hearing powers, approval, and costs verified.

headings.title: Director certification of merger order and articles
headings.reviewNote: Upon approval, director certifies order and forwards two copies of articles of merger to secretary of state.

headings.title: Secretary of state filing, certificate issuance, and fees
headings.reviewNote: Secretary of state files articles upon fee payment and issues certificate of merger to resulting company.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; director certification and secretary of state merger certificate issuance verified.

headings.title: Single surviving corporation designated in merger plan
headings.reviewNote: Merging corporations become single corporation designated in plan of merger as surviving corporation.

headings.title: Cessation of separate corporate existence of merged companies
headings.reviewNote: Separate existence of all corporations parties to plan of merger ceases except surviving corporation.

headings.title: Powers, duties, and liabilities of surviving mutual corporation
headings.reviewNote: Surviving corporation possesses all powers and is subject to all liabilities under sections 380.201 to 380.591.

headings.title: Automatic vesting of assets and real estate title
headings.reviewNote: All property, real estate title, franchises, and debts vest in surviving corporation without deed or conveyance.

headings.title: Assumption of liabilities and continuation of pending actions
headings.reviewNote: Survivor responsible for all liabilities; pending claims and actions continue without abatement; liens unimpaired.

headings.title: Amendment of articles of incorporation via merger terms
headings.reviewNote: Articles of incorporation of surviving corporation deemed amended to extent changes stated in merger articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 4 title; all six surviving-corporation merger effect subsections verified.

headings.title: Director qualifications, election, terms, and classified board
headings.reviewNote: Board of at least five directors, each an insured property owner; elected for 1-7 years; classified terms and vacancies.

headings.title: Annual member meeting, quorum threshold, and voting rules
headings.reviewNote: Annual meeting held per articles; minimum quorum of eight members; one vote per member; proxy only if articles allow.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); board qualifications/1–7 year classified terms and annual meeting quorum (8+)/proxy rules verified.

headings.title: Prohibition on using company funds for private gain
headings.reviewNote: Unlawful for officer, director, member, or employee to use company funds or securities for private profit.

headings.title: Class E felony penalty for willful financial self-dealing
headings.reviewNote: Willful use of company funds for private gain constitutes class E felony.

headings.title: Referral of self-dealing evidence for criminal prosecution
headings.reviewNote: Director may refer evidence of private fund misuse to prosecuting attorney or attorney general for criminal proceedings.

headings.title: Preservation of state power to prosecute other crimes
headings.reviewNote: Section does not limit power of state to punish person for conduct constituting crime under other state statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (effective 1-01-17); tightened subsection 1 title; private-gain prohibition, class E felony, § 27.030 referral, and preserved criminal authority verified.

headings.title: Director investment inquiry and public inspection records
headings.reviewNote: Director investigates manner in which funds or securities are invested, recording results for inspection by policyholders and officials.

headings.title: Prosecution of unlawful investment and fund misuse violations
headings.reviewNote: Prosecuting attorney or attorney general proceeds at once by information or indictment against violators of section 380.391.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; director investment inquiry records and mandatory prosecution of § 380.391 violations verified.

headings.title: Membership eligibility for individuals and entities
headings.reviewNote: Any person with insurable risk in territory may become member; public and private corporations, boards, and estates may hold policies.

headings.title: Representative capacity of officers and personal liability immunity
headings.reviewNote: Officers, trustees, and board members acting for entities recognized as members without personal liability on insurance contract.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; individual/entity membership eligibility and representative nonliability verified.

headings.title: Initial charges, annual collections, premiums, and assessments
headings.reviewNote: Board collects initial charge and annual amounts via premiums or assessments to pay losses and maintain guaranty fund.

headings.title: Purpose, maintenance, and distribution of guaranty fund
headings.reviewNote: Guaranty fund available only for losses and expenses; does not relieve assessment obligations; treated as asset upon dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); initial charges, premium vs assessment collection/disclosure, and guaranty fund maintenance/dissolution asset status verified.

headings.title: Exemption of extended mutuals from other insurance laws
headings.reviewNote: Extended mutuals exempt from other insurance laws unless specifically designated; future laws inapplicable unless expressly declared.

headings.title: Applicability of designated insurance laws to automobile coverage
headings.reviewNote: Subjects extended mutuals writing automobile insurance to §§ 375.445, 375.936–375.948, 379.110–379.120, 379.203, and 303.170–303.210 (original rolls read '380.590').

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 1984 note (effective 1-01-85), and original-rolls footnote ('380.590'); tightened subsection 1 title; general insurance-law exemption and automobile coverage statutory applicability verified.

headings.title: Prohibition on paying commissions to unlicensed agents
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits paying commission or compensation for procuring insurance except to licensed Missouri agent, agency, or broker (original rolls read '380.200 to 380.590').

headings.title: Application of producer licensing laws to agents
headings.reviewNote: Agents and brokers procuring contracts through extended mutuals subject to provisions of sections 375.012 to 375.146.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 1984 note (effective 1-01-85), and original-rolls footnote ('380.200 to 380.590'); tightened subsection 2 title; licensed-agent commission rule and §§ 375.012–375.146 applicability verified.

headings.title: Director administrative enforcement orders and violation levels
headings.reviewNote: Director may issue orders under section 374.046; violations are level two, except section 380.391 is level four; certificate revocable.

headings.title: Civil actions and penalty levels under section 374.048
headings.reviewNote: Director may maintain civil action for relief authorized under section 374.048 for violations or aiding violations of chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1984, 2007); tightened subsection 2 title; §§ 374.046/374.048 enforcement and § 374.049 level two (level four for § 380.391) violations verified.

headings.title: Conditions and one-year limitation on assessable policies
headings.reviewNote: Suit on assessable policy barred until loss due, 60 days after proof of loss, and within 12 months; declared on face page.

headings.title: Statute of limitations applicable to nonassessable policies
headings.reviewNote: Actions based upon policies issued on nonassessable basis subject to general statutes of limitations for similar causes of action.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; 60-day proof-of-loss/12-month assessable policy limitation and general nonassessable limitations verified.

headings.title: Prohibition on charter sale and misdemeanor penalty
headings.reviewNote: Unlawful for any person to sell corporate charter of Missouri mutual company; violation is class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Prior approval of management control contracts by director
headings.reviewNote: Requires filing and director approval of management/control contracts (source reads 'agreement of contract'), approved only if not detrimental to policyholders or public.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1984 note (effective 1-01-85); tightened subsection 1 title; class A misdemeanor charter sale ban and director approval of control contracts (verbatim 'agreement of contract' noted) verified.

headings.title: Short title of act
headings.reviewNote: Designates section as the 'Protecting Missouri's Mutual Insurance Companies Act'.

headings.title: Definitions of adequate and unlimited aggregate reinsurance
headings.reviewNote: Defines 'adequate reinsurance' and 'unlimited aggregate reinsurance' for purposes of section.

headings.title: Chapter 380 sole departmental authority and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Makes chapter 380 the department's sole authority except ch. 148 taxation and ch. 382 holding company systems, bars demanding waivers/concessions, and voids prior oversight concessions.

headings.title: Adequate reinsurance limit and annual March filings
headings.reviewNote: Bars requiring reinsurance beyond adequate reinsurance (including unlimited aggregate) and mandates annual March 1 reinsurance documentation and board resolution with 15-day adverse-event/liquidity notices.

headings.title: Limits and notice for proposed merger hearings
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits merger hearings notwithstanding § 380.321 absent substantial and competent evidence of policyholder prejudice, with 15-business-day review and 30–60 day hearing window.

headings.title: Confidentiality of examination records and disclosure exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Examination working papers confidential and exempt from subpoena; director may open final report or share with regulators.

headings.title: Reasonable fee limits, itemized billing, and budget conferences
headings.reviewNote: Caps exam rates at market rates notwithstanding § 380.491, provides optional 15-minute itemized monthly billing, scheduling conferences, and 30-day budget estimates (source reads 'expenses or the examination' in (2)(e)).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2024 S.B. 1359 note; replaced five completely mismatched draft titles/notes (subs 1–5 erroneously describing generic 5-year exams) with Protecting Missouri's Mutual Insurance Companies Act headings covering short title, reinsurance definitions, sole authority, March 1 filings, merger hearing limits, confidentiality, and exam billing/budget conferences.

headings.title: Applicability of insolvency and liquidation provisions
headings.reviewNote: Section applies to all mutual insurance companies operating under provisions of chapter 380.

headings.title: Statutory insolvency definition based on obligations and reserves
headings.reviewNote: Company is insolvent if unable to pay obligations when due or admitted assets fail to exceed liabilities plus required reserves.

headings.title: Application of statutory delinquency proceedings and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Sections 375.1150 to 375.1246 apply to chapter companies, excluding sections 375.1160 to 375.1164; sections 375.570-375.750 apply.

headings.title: Insolvent insurer status upon final order of liquidation
headings.reviewNote: Company deemed insolvent insurer under sections 375.771 to 375.779 upon entry of final court liquidation order.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2024 S.B. 1359 note; tightened subsection 2 title; chapter 380 insolvency definition, §§ 375.1150–375.1246/375.570–375.750 applicability (excluding §§ 375.1160–375.1164), and §§ 375.771–375.779 insolvent insurer status verified.
